title: Cover queued and human opening commit-failure rollback of deferred source selection
outcome: A behavior test proves queued or human opening commit failure restores the previous binding and root and the unapplied pending choice, then a later successful opening selects the requested claim.
acceptance: Inject an opening commit failure after deferred selection application; verify previous binding/root and unapplied pending choice restored, and verify a later successful opening selects the requested claim.
